G01.note: Random-looking strings revealed as an ordered record: disjointed vs systematic.

G02.note: Braced for disaster then finest writing: scathing then admiration.

G03.note: Glow drowned out vs total darkness: drab vs luminous; C is reversed.

G04.note: Precedent at every turn vs fine-or-flogging inconsistency: scrupulous ... erratic.

G05.note: Never needed to flee predators: unwary; insular is a near-trap.

G06.note: Narrow ruling leaving the rest to the council: restrained.

G07.note: Tempos carried in his head rather than on the page: written markings were cursory; idiosyncratic does not create the contrast.

G09.note: Shrinking rations and quarrels over shares: meager, once cordial.

G10.note: Sounds like an insult but means letting the music breathe: languid.

G11.note: Seldom speaks vs sharp constant commands: taciturn ... assertiveness.

G12.note: Dreaded comments, then checking every claim: unsparing ... scrupulous.

G13.note: Stops forty times per phrase: unrelenting; volatile blocked by never raising voice.

G14.note: Narrow setting yet wide emotional range: anything but insular.

G15.note: Recounting the same crabs inflated the tally: robust population.

G16.note: Jokes in lectures, exacting about decimals: genial ... fastidious.

G18.note: Veteran plus faster closing speed refutes deterioration; complacency is weaker.

G19.note: Face-saving wording rather than real settlement: cosmetic.

G20.note: Crowded with subplots vs editors changed nothing: sprawling ... impeccable.

G21.note: Invisible repairs now opposed by visible-repair conservators: seamlessly ... contentious.

G22.note: Far from everything, then artists priced out: remote ... exorbitant.

G24.note: Repeated until matched, yet felt invented on the spot: exhaustive ... spontaneous.

G25.note: Each clash placed where meaning turns: arbitrary vs deliberate.

G26.note: Each side quoted it as support: equivocal; rehearsed is a weak lure.

G28.note: Conceded it paid off long-term: shrewd.

G29.note: Borrowing vs unmistakably hers: imitative ... distinctive.

G30.note: Weak, possibly weather-driven correlation: tenuous at best.

G31.note: Once-generous allowances tightened: stringent; 'though temporary' rules out provisional.

G32.note: Many could not find it: inconspicuous.

G33.note: Promised relief, then demolitions revealed: appealing ... indignant.

G34.note: Loyalty vanished on price and a rival: conditional; habitual (mere habit, not loyalty) is arguable.

G35.note: Angles actually follow a strict rule: capricious refuted.

G36.note: Free trade except where it hurt them: selective.

G37.note: Casual delivery mistaken for indifference, but each comment was purposeful.

G38.note: Supermajorities make amendment arduous so the Constitution stays intact.
